Area.evidence_source: [/page/16/Text/7] Half the prisoners (21/42, 50%) believed that their act could have been prevented. Sometimes they thought this could have been achieved with a relatively easy solution, for example, a phone call, receiving necessary medication or being in a double cell: [/page/16/Text/8] Giving me my medication to make me feel normal. Then I would have been right as rain. I am back to normal now. I am okay now.
